successors.name: Great Moravia
successors.text: Nitra, driven out of by Mojmír I: 'Pribina was driven across the Danube by Mojmir, duke of the Moravians'

ledger.x: c. 825: Pribina rules an independent principality centred on Nitra. Infobox 'Independent state (825-833)', 'Established c. 825'; 'Pribina was initially the ruler of an independent polity which was centered on Nitra.' c. 833: Mojmír I of Moravia expels Pribina and takes Nitra. Mojmír expelled 'one Pribina' across the Danube and Pribina 'fled to Ratpot who administered the March of Pannonia from around 833'; he 'conquered the neighbouring principality of Nitra' in the early 830s. wars.name: Mojmír I's conquest of Nitra
wars.outcome: Mojmír I drove Pribina out and united Nitra with Moravia, the beginning of Great Moravia ('Mojmir's forced unification gave rise to Great Moravia', Principality of Nitra page).

certainty.note: No page gives a boundary; the principality is known by its centre at Nitra and the shape is Cliopatria's.
